evidence: Modifies CChain and block index handling in src/chain.h and src/chain.cpp to enforce non-null invariants via C++ references and std::reference_wrapper.
rationale: Refactors CChain and block index helpers to use references where null pointers are disallowed. The author characterizes this as a "slight improvement in code quality, maintainability and robustness" by creating a "more explicit representation of the non-null input invariant." Because it is an internal hygiene refactoring that fixes no existing bug, offers no performance benefit, and unblocks no larger feature, it ranks as marginal priority.
